title: Structural, optical, thermal, and computational insights into the 1D antimony-based hybrid perovskite (C10H13N4)[SbI4]·H2O
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,23335-23353
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA02020H, Paper
Open Access

Amin Alibi, Nour Elleuch, Sergiu Shova, Frédéric Amiard, Jerome Lhoste, Mohamed Boujelbene
A new one-dimensional organic–inorganic hybrid antimony halide, (C10H13N4)[SbI4]·H2O, was synthesized via a hydrothermal method and structurally characterized by single-crystal X-ray diffraction.
